source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently stage a complex photorealistic semantic-recognition test in which an original adult performer visibly plays a correctly scaled Korean geomungo, while the attached image informs only her visible facial appearance, hairstyle, makeup placement, and skin-surface finish.
subject: An original adult performer seated with a full-scale Korean geomungo, a long horizontal six-string wooden zither with fixed raised frets, played by contacting a string with a slender bamboo suldae.
setting: A coastal lighthouse keeper room during dense sea fog, adapted for a solitary night performance.
event: The performer makes a precise accented stroke at the instant a draft bends an oil-lamp flame and the moving lighthouse beam crosses the room.
visual_priorities: The complete horizontal geomungo, its fixed fret row, six thick strings, seated support, and both hand mechanics must be clearly readable at true instrument scale.
The suldae must be visibly held by the right hand with its tip in unmistakable string contact, while the left hand presses a string over a fixed fret.

Image 1 may guide only visible adult facial appearance, long dark wavy center-parted hair, softly defined eye makeup, muted rose lip color, and natural luminous skin-surface finish for an original performer.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic environmental portrait inside a coastal lighthouse keeper room during dense sea fog. An original adult performer sits cross-legged behind a full-scale Korean geomungo: a long dark wooden six-string zither extending horizontally across a low floor support and her lap, with a clearly readable row of fixed raised frets. Her left hand presses a string firmly over one fixed fret while her right hand grips a slender bamboo suldae, the suldae tip visibly contacting a string in a precise accented stroke. The fixed-fret structure, six thick strings, bamboo striking stick, and low seated playing posture make the instrument unmistakably geomungo in construction. An oil lamp flame bends in a draft at the instant of contact. Deep indigo room light is cut by one hard white sweep from the lighthouse optic. Use a 55 mm low seated viewpoint: the full zither forms a strong horizontal band, both endpoints remain in frame, the face occupies the upper third, and both hand contacts are unobstructed. Image 1 guides only the visible adult facial appearance, long dark wavy center-parted hair, softly defined eyes, muted rose lips, and natural luminous skin surface of this original adult performer.
